nodes.label: Ranger Vocation Icon (bow crossed with arrows)
nodes.description: Colored pixel-art icon of a brown/gold recurve bow with a green-wrapped grip, crossed diagonally by two white-fletched arrows. Depicts the Ranger vocation (ranged/paladin-style distance fighter class). Belongs to the Thaira vocation/class system; same chunky RPG pixel-art style with dark outlines and drop shadow.
